Trigonometry Calculator

Compute sin, cos, tan, csc, sec, cot for any angle in degrees or radians, plus inverse trig from a value.

Inverse trig (from a value)


  




  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter the angle and pick degrees or radians.
  2. Press Calculate for all six trig functions.
  3. Use the inverse section to get arcsin, arccos or arctan of a value.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
When are csc, sec or cot undefined?
When their reciprocal is zero: csc at 0°/180°, sec at 90°/270°, cot at 0°/180°.
What range does arcsin accept?
Values from −1 to 1 only, since sine never leaves that range; arctan accepts any real number.
What is the principal value?
Inverse trig returns one standard angle: arcsin in [−90°, 90°], arccos in [0°, 180°], arctan in (−90°, 90°).
